# Kirill Lebedev, PhD
> Director of Engineering | AI & Ads Measurement Leader

Kirill Lebedev, PhD is a technology executive based in the San Francisco Bay Area. He leads engineering organizations across artificial intelligence, distributed systems, and advertising technology.

## Core Executive Highlights
- Current Role: Director of Engineering at LinkedIn (Overall Ads Measurement Leader).
- Leadership Scope: 40–70+ person full-stack engineering organization across Audience, Identity, Incrementality, Recommendations, and Measurement charters.
- Commercial Scale: Bootstrapped LinkedIn's Brand Advertising business line from ground up to $1B+ in annual revenue (~20% of total ad revenue).
- AI Growth: Served as Engineering Lead for AI Ads products (LinkedIn Accelerate), accelerating revenue 6x to $100M+ ARR in six months.
- Institutional Governance: Multi-year company-wide hiring committee member and bar-raiser; technical due diligence for corporate acquisitions.
- Incrementality Coverage: 25% of total advertising revenue covered by incremental measurement with 2x incremental spend lift validated for enterprise adopters.
- Academic Credentials: PhD in Computer Science from Irkutsk National Research Technical University (INRTU); graduated summa cum laude with master's in systems engineering (GPA 5.0/5.0); former associate professor and deputy vice-rector.
- Contact: kirill@drlebedev.com | +1 (415) 799-9995 | San Francisco Bay Area, CA

## Issued United States Patents
- [US Patent 11,968,185](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11968185): On-Device Experimentation (Granted April 2024). Cryptographic buffers and client-side randomized treatment assignments for privacy-preserving statistical inference without server round-trips.
- [US Patent 11,232,254](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11232254): Editing Mechanism for Electronic Content Items (Granted January 2022). Algorithmic framework for dynamic multi-variant digital content composition and runtime structural validation with cryptographic content integrity.
- [US Patent 11,102,534](https://patents.google.com/patent/US11102534): Content Item Similarity Detection (Granted August 2021). Locality-sensitive hashing and high-dimensional vector embeddings for sub-millisecond similarity matching, automated content review, and creative deduplication.
